name: workspacenext.navigation-layout
description: Read the complete desktop ShellAPI navigation layout using the observed v2 record shape. Each record must have id and a bounded native type; optional key, visible, and movable values are bounded. URLs, logos, names, paths, and extras are excluded. No Shell native type is mapped to a settings enum.

evidence.snippet: entities.NavigationInfo fields mainNavigation repeated AppInfo and shortcutNavigation repeated AppInfo
entities.AppInfo fields ID required string, appType required string, unmovable bool

name: workspacenext.device-notify-preferences
description: Read four scalar desktop device-notification preferences using the protobuf-defined force-server request. Notification sound configuration and all unrecognized fields are excluded; parent should compare the result with desktop notification settings before treating it as UI-verified.

evidence.snippet: DeviceNotifySetting: disableMobileNotify, stillNotifyAt, showMessageDetail, stillNotifySpecialNotice, notificationSoundSetting

name: workspacenext.navigation-apps
description: Read up to 100 desktop navigation app identifiers, keys, type codes, and display names. The request is grounded by the bundled protobuf schema as desktop platform NAV_PC=1; parent must compare the live result with the desktop sidebar before treating it as UI-verified. URLs, logos, app extras, and platform metadata are excluded.

evidence.snippet: GetNavigationAppsRequest: platform field 1, enum settings.v1.NavigationPlatform; NavigationPlatform NAV_PC = 1
GetNavigationAppsResponse: repeated appInfo (.basic.v1.NavigationAppInfo); NavigationAppInfo fields id, key, appType, name, displayName

name: workspacenext.custom-status-intervals
description: Read up to 100 signed-in custom-status interval values needed to restore the precise fields changed by workspacenext.clear-custom-status. Titles, icons, sync flags, and other status fields are excluded.

name: workspacenext.time-format-preference
description: Read only the signed-in user's 12- or 24-hour display preference. The broad settings response is never returned.

name: workspacenext.calendar-resource-equipments
description: Read up to 100 calendar meeting-room equipment IDs with the localized names consumed by the shipped resource filter. This tenant-scoped catalog read excludes room availability, bookings, and raw resource graphs.
